arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using CampusSim; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { foreach(var b in Object.FindObjectsByType<CampusTerrainBinding>(FindObjectsInactive.Include,FindObjectsSortMode.None)) if(b.sourceId!=null&&b.sourceId.Contains("1390060991")) { string path=b.name; var t=b.transform.parent; while(t!=null){path=t.name+"/"+path;t=t.parent;} result.Log("road="+path+" active="+b.gameObject.activeInHierarchy+" mesh="+b.bakedMesh?.name); } foreach(var hit in Physics.RaycastAll(new Vector3(74.387f,1000,-468.534f),Vector3.down,2000)) result.Log("stop_hit="+hit.collider.name+" y="+hit.point.y); } }
